newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Toshiba unit to issue two bln yen MTN.
newsitem.headline: Toshiba unit to issue two bln yen MTN.

text.p: Toshiba Capital (Asia) Ltd, a unit of Toshiba Corp, will issue a two billion yen Euro Medium Term Note Programme, dealer Sakura Merchant Bank (Singapore) said on Friday.
The programme, in denominations of 100 million yen at an issue price of 100.35 percent, would have a payment date of June 19, 1997 and mature on June 19, 2000, it said in a statement.
The coupon would step up on every anniversary, paying 1.2 percent after the first year, 1.6 percent after the second year and 2.0 percent after the third.
The programme was rated A1 by Moody's and A by S&P, it said.
